description: Historical LPL identity media shared by test and processed datasets.

selection_policy.player: Match season, team ID and player ID. Prefer exact source split, then an earlier split in the same season/team. No cross-team or cross-year fallback.
selection_policy.team: Leaguepedia image revisions uploaded by 2025-01-12; OMG uses the official Tencent LPL asset dated 2023-01-03 in its URL.
selection_policy.missing: Use the neutral local placeholder; gaps are explicit.

source.date_basis: Date embedded in official asset URL; not an archive revision timestamp.

missing.reason: No verified 2025 headshot for this team in the consulted archive; other seasons/teams are not substituted.
